data.description:
## Context

When DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 (set by sprint orchestrator in Phase F), apply-attribution-trailers.sh must run even if attribution.enabled=false in project config. Without this override, every sprint commit in projects with attribution disabled will fail the check-sprint-trailer hook (S3).

## Done Definitions

- COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md 'Attribution Pre-Commit' section documents that when DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 is set, the attribution.enabled=false config check is bypassed and apply-attribution-trailers.sh always runs
- apply-attribution-trailers.sh itself is updated (or wrap-call site in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md instructs it) to detect DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 and skip the attribution.enabled guard
- A structural test asserts the DSO_SPRINT_MODE override logic is documented in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md

## Testing Mode

UPDATE

## Files to Modify

- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (Attribution Pre-Commit section)
- plugins/dso/scripts/apply-attribution-trailers.sh (add DSO_SPRINT_MODE override guard)
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh or new structural test file (assert override documented)
data.title: UPDATE COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md: force attribution when DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1
